title: Theme Core
description: A four-image reference-led core set for Before-After Proof Carousel.
creative_direction: Start with one anchor image, then preserve the same visual system across three downstream variations.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-variation-one, 03-variation-two, 04-variation-three. Queue may run 02-variation-one, 03-variation-two, 04-variation-three concurrently after 01-reference-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
